policy: Gate optional dependency ports behind base-tool blockers; port bounded conversion/runtime cores, not whole applications, and reuse shared ports across lanes with honest upstream/full-suite evidence.

items.name: Shared ZIP/package container core
items.source: PKWARE APPNOTE; local evidence in lanes/pandoc/UPSTREAM_TEST_MANIFEST.json and lanes/markerpdf/UPSTREAM_TEST_MANIFEST.json
items.essentialCapability: Unlocks DOCX, EPUB, ODT, benchmark archive, and cloud archive package inspection without shelling out to zip tools.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: central directory parsing, stored/deflated entries, CRC checks, path safety, deterministic writing, and package-level metadata hooks. Out of scope: full office suites, encrypted archives, arbitrary native zip extensions, and application launchers.
items.testExpectation: Create a dependency-specific ZIP spec/upstream denominator with mapped Pandoc/markerPDF package fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, round-trip entry tests, malformed/corrupt archive cases, and no progress credit for shelling out to zip/unzip or external package tools.
items.reuseNotes: Use as the common package layer for DOCX, EPUB, ODT, markerPDF benchmark archives, and any rclone archive backend work.

items.name: XML and HTML5 parse/serialize core
items.source: WHATWG HTML, XML 1.0, and local upstream evidence in pandoc, readability, markerpdf, and difftastic manifests
items.essentialCapability: Provides shared safe parsing and serialization for legacy HTML imports, DocBook/XML, SVG/image metadata, WXR review, and structural HTML diffs.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: tokenizer/tree construction needed by readers, namespaces, entities, comments, fragments, and safe serializers. Out of scope: browser layout, JavaScript execution, CSS cascade/layout, network fetching, and full DOM API compatibility.
items.testExpectation: Create a dependency-specific WHATWG/XML spec denominator with mapped lane fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, round-trip parse/serialize tests, malformed/corrupt input cases, explicit browser-only exclusions, and no progress credit for shelling out to external DOM/converter engines.
items.reuseNotes: Prefer one parser/serializer surface reused by Pandoc HTML/DocBook, Readability cleanup, markerPDF HTML/image output, and Difftastic HTML/XML tokenization.

items.name: DOCX/OpenXML document core
items.source: Pandoc DOCX reader/writer upstream in https://github.com/jgm/pandoc plus OpenXML/OPC package specifications
items.essentialCapability: Enables Word document import/export into the shared Pandoc AST and WordPress block handoff.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: document.xml, relationships, content types, numbering, styles used for semantic AST conversion, media references, and bounded writer output. Out of scope: Word/LibreOffice automation, VBA/macros, exact page layout, revision UI, and full OOXML application compatibility.
items.testExpectation: Require a DOCX/OpenXML-specific upstream/spec denominator, mapped fixture packages, PHP pass/fail evidence, semantic AST parity checks, media relationship tests, malformed/corrupt package cases, and no progress credit for shelling out to Word, LibreOffice, Pandoc, or external converters.
items.reuseNotes: Build on shared-zip-package-core and xml-html5-dom-core; expose media and relationship helpers to EPUB/ODT where possible.

items.name: Legacy DOC/Compound File Binary extraction core
items.source: Microsoft MS-CFB and MS-DOC specifications plus Pandoc rich-format import need recorded in the portfolio goal and pandoc lane
items.essentialCapability: Adds bounded Word 97-2003 .doc text/structure extraction into the shared Pandoc AST and WordPress block handoff without treating DOCX/OpenXML as equivalent.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: Compound File Binary container directory/FAT/MiniFAT reads, WordDocument/0Table/1Table stream discovery, FIB/piece-table text extraction, paragraph/list/table hints where fixture-backed, basic metadata, and safe error reporting. Out of scope: Word/LibreOffice/OpenOffice automation, embedded OLE object execution, VBA/macros, exact page layout, binary converter subprocesses, and full office-suite compatibility.
items.testExpectation: Require a DOC/CFB-specific MS-CFB/MS-DOC spec denominator, mapped legacy .doc fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, text/paragraph/table/list extraction parity, malformed/corrupt CFB/FIB/stream cases, and no progress credit for shelling out to Word, LibreOffice/OpenOffice, antiword/wv, Pandoc, or external converters.
items.reuseNotes: Reuse charset/unicode repair, table geometry, and shared AST helpers; keep this separate from docx-openxml-core because .doc is CFB/binary Word, not ZIP/OpenXML.

items.name: EPUB package and spine core
items.source: Pandoc EPUB reader/writer upstream in https://github.com/jgm/pandoc plus W3C EPUB 3 specifications
items.essentialCapability: Allows ebook and exported article packages to become WordPress-ready content with ordered spine, metadata, assets, and navigation preserved.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: container.xml, OPF package metadata, spine/nav/NCX mapping, XHTML asset resolution, media manifest handling, and bounded writer packages. Out of scope: DRM, ebook rendering engines, store-specific validators, and embedded scripting execution.
items.testExpectation: Track an EPUB-specific W3C/upstream denominator with mapped package fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, spine/nav/metadata/assets parity, generated-package readback, malformed/corrupt archive cases, and no progress credit for shelling out to ebook converters or external validators.
items.reuseNotes: Reuse ZIP, XML/HTML, charset, and media helpers shared with DOCX/ODT and Readability imports.

items.name: OpenDocument text package core
items.source: Pandoc ODT/OpenDocument reader/writer upstream in https://github.com/jgm/pandoc plus OASIS OpenDocument specifications
items.essentialCapability: Adds bounded LibreOffice/OpenOffice document package import/export without porting the office applications.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: ODT manifest, content.xml, styles.xml, meta.xml, text/list/table/image mapping required for AST conversion, and bounded writer output. Out of scope: LibreOffice/OpenOffice apps, spreadsheets/presentations unless separately gated, macro execution, and pixel-perfect layout.
items.testExpectation: Require an ODT/OpenDocument-specific OASIS/upstream denominator, mapped ODT fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, semantic AST comparison, style/list/table/media coverage, package readback and malformed/corrupt package cases, explicit unsupported office-suite behavior, and no progress credit for shelling out to LibreOffice/OpenOffice or external converters.
items.reuseNotes: Use shared ZIP/package and XML cores; table and Unicode width helpers should be shared with Pandoc Markdown/HTML table work.

items.name: PDF text dictionary extraction core
items.source: markerPDF marker/pdf/extract_text.py evidence and pdftext dependency recorded in lanes/markerpdf/UPSTREAM_TEST_MANIFEST.json
items.essentialCapability: Converts searchable PDF page text, spans, boxes, fonts, rotations, and TOC metadata into structured import blocks.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: supplied pdftext-compatible dictionary schema, bounded PDF text operator/content-stream extraction, page ranges, span IDs, boxes, font flags, and metadata handoff. Out of scope: full PDF renderer, JavaScript/actions, forms/signatures beyond explicitly mapped handoff metadata, and PDFium process wrappers.
items.testExpectation: Use a PDF-text/pdftext-specific upstream/spec denominator with markerPDF benchmark/reference pairs and synthetic PDF-text fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, dictionary conversion and page slicing parity, malformed/corrupt PDF/dictionary cases, and no progress credit for live pdftext subprocess calls or external PDF converters.
items.reuseNotes: Feed markerPDF document extraction now and later Pandoc PDF-oriented intermediate imports; share geometry primitives with table and OCR cores.

items.name: PDF page render and crop planning core
items.source: markerPDF marker/images/extract.py, marker_app.py preview, and debug render evidence in lanes/markerpdf/UPSTREAM_TEST_MANIFEST.json
items.essentialCapability: Provides deterministic page boxes, crop payloads, image placeholders, and preview metadata for OCR, tables, equations, and WordPress media review.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: page count, page boxes, crop rectangles, renderer callback contracts, image placeholder naming, debug overlay plans, and safe image metadata. Out of scope: native PDFium, PIL, Ghostscript, or full raster engine ports; actual rendering may be supplied by bounded adapters.
items.testExpectation: Require a PDF page/render-planning upstream/spec denominator with mapped page/crop/debug fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, supplied-renderer contract tests, malformed/corrupt page-box cases, explicit live-raster blockers, and no progress credit for PDFium/PIL/Ghostscript/Poppler or external render engines.
items.reuseNotes: Share page geometry and media handoff with pdf-text-dictionary-core, table-geometry-core, and layout-ocr-result-core.

items.name: Layout and OCR result core
items.source: markerPDF marker/ocr/recognition.py, marker/layout/layout.py, OCRMyPDF/Tesseract planning, and Surya result evidence in lanes/markerpdf/UPSTREAM_TEST_MANIFEST.json
items.essentialCapability: Allows scanned or garbled PDFs to enter the same structured document path through OCR language, polygon, line, and page-result handoffs.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: language maps, OCR job planning, hOCR/TSV/plain-result ingestion, supplied Surya-style layout/OCR predictions, polygon scaling, stats, and page replacement. Out of scope: porting Tesseract, OCRMyPDF, Ghostscript, Torch, Surya, Texify, or model inference.
items.testExpectation: Require an OCR/layout-result upstream/spec denominator with supplied OCR/layout fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, language-map and polygon/page-result tests, malformed/corrupt result cases, explicit full-runner blockers, and no progress credit for Tesseract/OCRMyPDF/Ghostscript/Surya/Torch/Texify or external OCR/model engines.
items.reuseNotes: Uses PDF geometry and Unicode repair; output should feed markerPDF and later any Pandoc PDF import pathway.

items.name: Table geometry and formatter core
items.source: markerPDF tabled-pdf evidence in lanes/markerpdf/UPSTREAM_TEST_MANIFEST.json plus Pandoc table fixture evidence
items.essentialCapability: Turns PDF, HTML, and document table structure into usable Markdown, HTML, and WordPress table blocks with spans and alignment preserved.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: bbox row/column assignment, spanning, multiline cell merge, heuristic column clustering, Unicode-width Markdown padding, CSV/HTML/Markdown formatting, and AST table handoff. Out of scope: CV table-detection model inference, spreadsheet engines, and arbitrary visual layout reconstruction.
items.testExpectation: Use a table-geometry upstream/spec denominator with markerPDF benchmark/reference data and Pandoc/Readability table fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, geometry/spanning/Unicode-width/formatter parity, malformed/corrupt table-result cases, and no progress credit for CV table-detection model or spreadsheet engine shell-outs.
items.reuseNotes: Share row/column and width helpers across markerPDF PDF tables, Pandoc Markdown/HTML/DOCX/ODT tables, and Readability table cleanup.

items.name: Unicode repair, width, and segmentation core
items.source: python-ftfy concepts, Unicode UAX #11/#14/#29, and local markerPDF/Pandoc/Difftastic evidence
items.essentialCapability: Keeps imported text, tables, diffs, identifiers, and excerpts readable when source content contains mojibake, combining marks, East Asian width, or zero-width characters.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: NFC normalization, selected mojibake/C1 repair, entity-aware text repair, grapheme/display-width calculations, line wrapping helpers, and stable segmentation. Out of scope: translation, spellchecking, NLP, and locale-specific typography beyond fixture-backed rules.
items.testExpectation: Create a Unicode/ftfy/UAX-specific denominator with mapped Pandoc, Difftastic, Readability, LightningCSS, and markerPDF text fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, normalization/width/segmentation parity, malformed byte/entity/mojibake cases, and no progress credit for shelling out to external text-repair engines.
items.reuseNotes: Avoid per-lane duplicate width/repair logic; expose deterministic helpers for table, diff, OCR, and content cleanup lanes.

items.name: Charset and byte-decoding core
items.source: WHATWG Encoding Standard plus difftastic UTF-16/mostly-valid UTF-8 evidence and Readability/Pandoc import needs
items.essentialCapability: Allows non-UTF-8 exports, WXR files, source diffs, and document imports to decode consistently before structural parsing.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: BOM handling, UTF-8/UTF-16, Windows-1252 and declared charset handling, replacement policy, binary detection hints, and safe byte-span preservation. Out of scope: broad statistical charset detection unless a fixture-backed slice is explicitly gated.
items.testExpectation: Require a WHATWG Encoding/upstream-lane denominator with mapped byte fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, expected decoded text, binary-vs-text decisions, span preservation, malformed/corrupt sequence behavior, and no progress credit for shelling out to iconv/recode-style external converters.
items.reuseNotes: Should sit below Difftastic file decoding, Pandoc/Readability HTML imports, markerPDF text repair, and rclone manifest reads.

items.name: Source Map v3 parser and writer core
items.source: Source Map v3 specification plus esbuild and LightningCSS upstream manifest evidence
items.essentialCapability: Preserves JS/CSS bundle traceability for shared-hosting builds and review UIs without requiring Node tooling.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: VLQ mappings, sources/sourceContent, names, sections where needed, path normalization, and deterministic writer output. Out of scope: bundler transforms, minification, browser devtools integration, and live filesystem watchers.
items.testExpectation: Require a Source Map v3/upstream denominator with mapped esbuild/LightningCSS fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, malformed/corrupt VLQ/section cases, round-trip writer tests, fixture-level path normalization, and no progress credit for shelling out to Node bundlers or external source-map tools.
items.reuseNotes: One core should serve esbuild JS/TS output and LightningCSS CSS output; Difftastic can consume it for mapped review spans later.

items.name: Tree-sitter grammar/query compatibility subset
items.source: Difftastic upstream tree-sitter parser evidence and selected grammar fixtures recorded in lanes/difftastic/UPSTREAM_TEST_MANIFEST.json
items.essentialCapability: Improves syntax-aware structural diffs for code, block assets, and embedded HTML style/script sections.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: selected grammar metadata, node-type/query/highlight compatibility, fixture-backed delimiter semantics, and language-specific token trees needed by review output. Out of scope: porting every tree-sitter grammar, native parser generator/runtime completeness, and Cargo build integration.
items.testExpectation: Require a tree-sitter/grammar-specific upstream denominator with per-language mapped sample/golden fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, syntax-highlight query parity, malformed/corrupt parse-error and unsupported-grammar fallbacks, and no progress credit for invoking tree-sitter/Cargo parsers as external engines.
items.reuseNotes: Prefer consuming native esbuild/LightningCSS parsers for JS/CSS where feasible before adding grammar-specific duplicate parsers.

items.name: Protocol Buffers wire-format core
items.source: Syncthing BEP/protocol evidence in lanes/syncthing/UPSTREAM_TEST_MANIFEST.json and Protocol Buffers wire-format documentation
items.essentialCapability: Supports durable Syncthing BEP message serialization, unknown-field preservation, and protocol fixture parity.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: varints, fixed32/fixed64, length-delimited fields, repeated fields, unknown-field retention, and hand-written message schemas needed by Syncthing. Out of scope: protoc compiler implementation, reflection/runtime generation, gRPC, and unrelated protobuf APIs.
items.testExpectation: Require a Protocol Buffers/BEP wire-format denominator with mapped Syncthing wire fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, malformed/corrupt varint/message cases, round-trip message tests, unknown-field retention checks, and no progress credit for invoking protoc or external protobuf runtimes.
items.reuseNotes: Keep message codec separate from Syncthing session logic so future protocol lanes can reuse it.

items.name: Checksum and hash suite
items.source: rclone fs/hash evidence, gitoxide object evidence, quadrable BLAKE2s evidence, and OneDrive QuickXorHash evidence in lane manifests
items.essentialCapability: Provides shared streaming integrity checks for storage sync, Git objects, sparse Merkle data, PDF benchmark artifacts, and protocol payloads.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: streaming CRC32/CRC32C where required, MD5/SHA variants where safe for compatibility, BLAKE2s already mapped by Quadrable, QuickXorHash, hash manifests, and constant-time compare helpers where relevant. Out of scope: TLS, password hashing, new cryptographic protocol design, and secret handling.
items.testExpectation: Inventory a dependency-specific upstream/spec denominator per algorithm, map lane fixtures and official vectors, record PHP pass/fail evidence, include large/streaming/chunked and malformed/truncated payload cases, preserve compatibility quirks, mark security limitations, and give no progress credit for shelling out to external hash tools.
items.reuseNotes: Consolidates duplicate hashing from rclone, Gitoxide, Quadrable, Syncthing, and markerPDF benchmark/archive evidence.

items.name: Archive and compression stream helpers
items.source: rclone lib/readers/gzip/archive evidence, Pandoc package needs, and PHP zlib-compatible fixture expectations
items.essentialCapability: Enables deterministic gzip/tar/archive reads and writes for sync, packaged documents, PDF benchmark data, and Git pack-adjacent workflows.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: streaming gzip/deflate wrappers, tar/PAX metadata needed by archive providers, safe extraction paths, and bounded writer output. Out of scope: every archive format, encrypted archives, external decompressor wrappers, and OS-level mount behavior.
items.testExpectation: Require an archive/compression upstream/spec denominator with mapped rclone/Pandoc/markerPDF/Gitoxide fixtures, PHP pass/fail evidence, streaming reader/writer tests, malformed/corrupt/truncated archive cases, interoperability readback from local generated fixtures, and no progress credit for shelling out to tar/gzip/decompressor tools.
items.reuseNotes: Layer ZIP-specific package work separately, but share compression/path-safety primitives where practical.

items.name: Glob, ignore, and pathspec matcher core
items.source: rclone fs/filter, Syncthing ignore, Git sparse/pathspec, and esbuild entry/filter evidence in lane manifests
items.essentialCapability: Keeps include/exclude, sparse checkout, sync ignore, and review-file selection behavior consistent across tooling.
items.scopeBoundary: In scope: glob syntax, include/exclude order, rooted and recursive matching, case-sensitivity controls, path normalization, and lane-specific compatibility adapters. Out of scope: filesystem watchers, live provider traversal, shell glob expansion, and arbitrary regex engines beyond mapped needs.
items.testExpectation: Create a glob/pathspec upstream/spec denominator with a cross-lane fixture matrix for rclone filters, Syncthing ignores, Git pathspec/sparse rules, esbuild entry matching, and Difftastic overrides, record PHP pass/fail evidence, include malformed pattern/path cases, and no progress credit for shelling out to Git/rclone/shell glob engines.
items.reuseNotes: Prevents each lane from growing incompatible path-matching dialects; adapters can preserve upstream-specific error text.
